name: Refugee Quota Programme (Offshore Resettlement)

qualifying_event.description: New Zealand resettles up to 1,500 refugees per year (combining the Refugee Quota Programme and Community Organisation Refugee Sponsorship) from offshore, selected from UNHCR-recognized and referred mandated refugees, allocated 50% Asia-Pacific, 20% Middle East, 20% Africa, 10% Americas. Immigration New Zealand additionally assesses credibility, settlement capacity, security, immigration risk, and health.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: UNHCR mandated-refugee recognition and referral (or qualifying family-member exemption); INZ assessment on credibility/settlement/security/health grounds.

requirements.blocker_text: Must be recognised as a mandated refugee and referred to New Zealand by UNHCR (with some exemptions for family members of a principal applicant).
Capped at 1,500 places per year combined across the Refugee Quota Programme and Community Organisation Refugee Sponsorship.

evidence_required.document: UNHCR mandated-refugee recognition and NZ referral

outcome.duration_length: indefinite (Permanent Resident status granted on arrival)

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand -- Refugee Quota Programme: 1,500/year combined quota, UNHCR referral requirement, regional allocation, Permanent Residence granted on arrival, 5-week Mangere Refugee Resettlement Centre orientation, up to 2 years' settlement support

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (New Zealand). Distinct from nz_international_protection.json (the in-country claim process): quota refugees are referred by UNHCR from OFFSHORE and receive Permanent Residence immediately on arrival, with no residence-visa-then-conversion step, whereas an in-country claimant applies for a Resident Visa only after a successful claim (see nz_international_protection.json). selection_method modeled 'nomination_required' since UNHCR referral -- not individual application -- is the entry point.
